qualification.en: The line says who should pay more, not whether the federal government should collect more or less in total. It is shown and not scored.

quote: Democrats will make billionaires pay a minimum income tax rate of 25 percent

sourceTitle.en: 2024 Democratic Party Platform (PDF, undated; text published by the DNC in its press release of August 18, 2024, for a delegate vote the next day), p. 16

summary.en: The platform says Democrats will make billionaires pay a minimum income tax rate of 25 percent.
